name: @bess/india-tariffs-crawler
description: Automated discovery-zone crawler for India C&I tariff authoritative sources. See docs/architecture/AUTHORITATIVE_TARIFF_CRAWLER_ARCHITECTURE.md.

scripts.crawl: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js crawl
scripts.verify: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js verify
scripts.migrate: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js migrate
scripts.migrate:production: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js migrate --production
scripts.registry:load: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js registry-load
scripts.source-health: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js source-health
